objective: Give every isolated run_validations() call a private, request-unique, explicitly exec-probed scratch directory instead of inheriting TMPDIR/HOME from a mount that may be noexec, fail closed when no candidate is exec-capable, and never weaken Landlock/bubblewrap scope, shell-free argv parsing, credential isolation, or the isolated task-queue DB.

root_cause.summary: run_validations() set TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP to workspace.home/tmp (landlock) or bubblewrap's private /tmp, both of which can live on a noexec-mounted filesystem. A validation command that compiled a native ELF into TMPDIR and then executed it got rc=126 (permission denied) even though the compiled product itself was correct -- an infrastructure failure indistinguishable, at the worker level, from a genuine product/test bug.

fix_summary: Added provision_validation_exec_scratch(): tries an optional admin-pinned AIWORKHUB_VALIDATION_EXEC_SCRATCH_ROOT override, else /dev/shm then the system tempdir, in order.

Each candidate gets a request-unique 0700 subdirectory (rejects a pre-existing symlink or directory at that exact path) that is then explicitly exec-probed with _probe_exec_capable_dir() before being trusted.

_probe_exec_capable_dir() creates its own probe file via an atomic O_CREAT|O_EXCL open with mode=0700 (no separate chmod/fchmod call), writes a trivial shell script, and executes it; PermissionError/timeout means the candidate is rejected and cleaned up, and the next candidate is tried.

If every candidate fails, provision_validation_exec_scratch() raises WorkspaceError("validation_exec_scratch_unavailable:...") -- fail closed before any validation command ever runs, never a silent rc=126 deep inside the worker's own compile step.

sandbox_argv() gained an optional validation_exec_scratch parameter: for landlock it is passed as a new --exec-scratch flag consumed by _landlock_exec/_apply_landlock (granted the same full mutate rights as home, via an explicit Landlock path-beneath rule -- never a chmod or remount of a shared filesystem); for bubblewrap it is bind-mounted writable at /validation-exec-scratch.

run_validations() provisions one scratch directory per call (shared across every validation command in that run), overrides TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP to point at it (the real path for landlock, /validation-exec-scratch for bubblewrap), and tears it down in a finally block that runs on every exit path: full success, a validation command's non-zero exit (validation_failed), subprocess.TimeoutExpired (converted to a WorkspaceError("validation_timeout:...") ), or any other exception (e.g. an external cancellation) propagating out of the function.

No change to Landlock/bubblewrap filesystem scope beyond the one new, request-private, non-shared exec-scratch grant; no shell_true; no chmod/remount of any shared/parent path; provider credential passthrough and the isolated task-queue DB env var are untouched.

coverage: test_compile_and_execute_native_binary_succeeds_via_provisioned_scratch: compile+execute success (the exact B751 shape, now fixed)
test_deliberate_product_failure_propagates_as_validation_failed: deliberate test/product failure propagates with its own rc, distinct from an exec-scratch failure
test_compiler_failure_propagates_with_its_own_rc_not_126: a genuine compile error surfaces with the compiler helper's own rc, never confused with rc=126
test_scratch_removed_after_successful_run / _after_deliberate_validation_failure / _after_abrupt_cancellation_like_exception: cleanup on every exit path
test_symlink_at_scratch_path_is_rejected / test_preexisting_regular_scratch_directory_is_rejected: fail-closed symlink and pre-existing-path rejection

test_fails_closed_when_every_candidate_is_noexec: decision-layer reproduction of the B751 shape -- every candidate reachable/writable but none exec-capable -> clean WorkspaceError before any validation command runs, no debris left behind

test_reproduces_b751_permission_denied_signature_distinct_from_product_rc: portable reproduction of the exact rc=126 kernel signature (PermissionError on exec of a non-executable file) without requiring a real noexec mount or root, and confirms the probe is not fooled by it
test_validation_env_never_leaks_adapter_credentials: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN/OPENAI_API_KEY are absent from the validation subprocess env and its output

test_concurrent_validation_runs_get_isolated_scratch_directories / test_concurrent_provisioning_produces_distinct_named_directories: concurrent requests get distinct, non-interfering scratch directories

existing_suite_regression_check.note: Identical failed/error test names before and after this change (verified by diffing the run against an unmodified worker_workspace.py in the same shell). Every failure/error traces to git init or fchmod/chmod raising PermissionError, or site.getusersitepackages() not existing under this session's synthetic HOME -- this authoring/worker session runs inside the exact Landlock+seccomp sandbox worker_workspace.py implements (confirmed via /proc/self/status: Seccomp=2, NoNewPrivs=1, and a bare `os.chmod`/`git init` failing identically with zero code changes), which unconditionally denies chmod-family syscalls for this whole process tree, including child processes such as git itself. None of the failures reference any line this task touched.

process_launcher_tests.result: not runnable from this isolated worktree: process_launcher.py imports aiworkhub.project_context, an untracked file present in the live parent repo but outside this task's read_first/allowed_writes, so it was not seeded into this worktree by create_workspace(). tools/aiworkhub/src/aiworkhub/process_launcher.py was not modified by this task (not in allowed_writes) and run_validations()'s public signature (workspace, commands, *, timeout_seconds=...) is unchanged, so process_launcher.py's one call site (run_validations(workspace, metadata.get('validation') or [])) is source-compatible with no code review needed beyond that signature check.
